page.title: Branded Codes, Combat Tips & Beginner Guide
page.meta_description: Find Branded codes, learn how to redeem them, and get started in this dark-fantasy Roblox RPG with combat, classes, and Ascension tips.
page.tagline: A dark-fantasy Roblox RPG where death leaves a mark and every build pushes you toward Apostle or Godhand.
overview: Branded is a dark-fantasy Roblox RPG from Dead Gods Interactive, currently in open beta. The Roblox description tells players to find codes in the game's Community Server, then redeem them in-game through TAB (PC) or SELECT (console) > SETTINGS > CODES. No individual codes are listed on the store page, so the Community Server is the place to check.

Combat is built around timing: parry, dodge, break guards, and learn weapons including swords, spears, axes, bows, wands, and legendary blades. You choose a race, class, and build, then either master a unique class or become a Hybrid with two weapons.

The Branded can never truly rest. Death leaves its mark, and progression pushes toward Ascension: devour your way into becoming an Apostle, or sacrifice someone you love to reach the Godhand. Expect open-beta bugs and balance changes while you play.

how_to_play: Start Branded on Roblox and choose your race and class.
Pick a weapon path—swords, spears, axes, bows, wands, or legendary blades—and shape a build around it.
In fights, parry, dodge, and break guards; the combat is skill-based and weighty, so timing matters.
Decide whether to master one class or go Hybrid with two weapons and combine their strengths.
Choose an Ascension route: devour to become an Apostle or sacrifice a loved one to reach Godhand.
For codes, join the Community Server, then open TAB (PC) or SELECT (console) > Settings > Codes and enter what you find.

tips: Practice parrying and dodging before committing to long fights; guard breaks can open up damage.
If you like flexibility, Hybrid lets you use two weapons and mix their strengths; if not, focus a single class.
Death leaves a mark, so avoid careless fights while learning the open beta.
Check the Community Server for codes and redeem them under Settings > Codes.
Expect balance shifts and bugs during open beta; treat early builds as experiments.

faq.q: How do I redeem codes in Branded?
faq.a: Open TAB on PC or SELECT on console, go to Settings > Codes, and enter a code.

faq.q: Where can I find Branded codes?
faq.a: The Roblox page says to find codes in the game's Community Server. It does not list individual codes on the store page.

faq.q: What platforms can I play Branded on?
faq.a: Branded is played on Roblox, which lists PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation, and VR.
